limitations: Cache state is unknown without per-cache log evidence; unknown is never called warm or cold.
Job scheduling delay may include dependency waiting; it is not runner queue time.
Wall clock ends at the final job, not the mutable workflow updated_at timestamp.
Cancelled and failed runs do not measure successful lifecycle performance.
Historical modes are inferred from executed job names; compare exact inputs before claiming improvement.

linux-native-current.condition: ${{ always() && needs.preflight.result == 'success' && needs.preflight.outputs.reuse_qualified != 'true' && needs.preflight.outputs.linux_qualification_only != 'true' && needs.preflight.outputs.linux_required == 'true' && inputs.linux_evidence_run_id == '' && (needs.linux.result == 'success' || inputs.linux_artifact_run_id != '') && needs.compositor-runtime-public.result == 'success' && (needs.qualification-supabase.result == 'success' || inputs.supabase_module_run_id != '') && (needs.qualification-semantic-search.result == 'success' || inputs.semantic_search_module_run_id != '') && (needs.qualification-ocr.result == 'success' || inputs.ocr_module_run_id != '') }}

compositor-runtime-public.name: Sign and bind opt-in compositor runtime companions

linux-full-parity-evidence.name: Linux full parity evidence gate
linux-full-parity-evidence.condition: ${{ always() && needs.preflight.result == 'success' && needs.preflight.outputs.reuse_qualified != 'true' && needs.preflight.outputs.linux_qualification_only != 'true' && (needs.linux-native-current.result == 'success' || inputs.linux_evidence_run_id != '') && needs.preflight.outputs.linux_required == 'true' && (needs.linux.result == 'success' || needs.preflight.outputs.linux_artifact_run_id != github.run_id) && (needs.preflight.outputs.compositor_runtime_required != 'true' || needs.compositor-runtime-public.result == 'success') }}

qualify.name: qualify
qualify.condition: ${{ always() && needs.preflight.result == 'success' && (needs.preflight.outputs.reuse_qualified == 'true' || (needs.macos.result == 'success' && needs.macos-regression.result == 'success' && needs.android.result == 'success' && needs.windows.result == 'success' && (needs.preflight.outputs.linux_required != 'true' || ((needs.linux.result == 'success' || needs.preflight.outputs.linux_artifact_run_id != github.run_id) && needs.linux-full-parity-evidence.result == 'success' && (needs.preflight.outputs.compositor_runtime_required != 'true' || needs.compositor-runtime-public.result == 'success'))))) }}
